metaDescription: Search for a topic you love and play a quiz on it in your own language.
title: Quiz Night
tagline: Pick a topic, answer ten questions and see how long a streak you can build.
searchHint: Typos are fine, and so is leaving out accents.
noMatches: Nothing matches “{query}”. Try a broader word.
resultsPerfect: A perfect round. Take a bow!
resultsGood: Great playing. Can you beat it?
resultsLow: Every expert started somewhere. Have another go!
shortQuiz: This round is shorter than usual: there aren’t many questions on this topic in your language yet.
errorTopics: We couldn’t load the topics just now. Please try again in a moment.
errorQuestions: We couldn’t load questions for this topic just now. Please try again in a moment.
emptyQuiz: There are no questions on this topic in your language yet. Try another one!
